Results.Name: A clean offline ZIP is checked in isolation without changing a running installation
A checked staged update preserves settings and data and keeps the previous program
An active application prevents installation and is never forcibly terminated
A tampered staged program cannot pass the final pre-install check
Traversal, absolute paths, ADS names and Windows path aliases are rejected before extraction
Duplicate paths, link entries and extra development files cannot enter a clean update
Malformed metadata and incomplete manifests cannot replace the installed program
Staging cleanup refuses ordinary user folders and invalid markers
The helper waits for the running app to release its lock and then installs

Scope: Offline package validation, isolated staging, lock waits, report and settings preservation, rollback copy, corruption, traversal, duplicate paths, link entries and cleanup safeguards. No downloaded code executed.
